cards.title: LIMEN Helix — Recursion Across Domains
cards.thesis: A single phase pattern — P0 Source → P10 Resurrection, with a 7b Divergence branch — recurs across body, mind, myth, ecology, and narrative. The universal arc: Build → Strain → Fracture → Realign → Reinvent.
concepts: Phase 7 is a tension/fracture threshold where systems either fail or transform — pattern logic in complex systems, NOT magical causality tied to a number.
Phase 0 (Source) and Phase 7b (Divergence) are the two markers most existing models omit; including them is what lets the arc describe collapse AND renewal.
The arc is cyclic and can terminate (collapse) or resurrect (renewal); completion of the spiral is what distinguishes durable change from recurrence.
The framework organizes existing systems theory into one sequential, phase-aware scaffold — it does not invent new science.

crossDomainExamples.religion: Ecclesiastes — 'nothing new under the sun' names the cycle; meaning is found in the rhythm and return, not in novelty.
crossDomainExamples.physiology: Midlife neuroendocrine shift maps to a Phase-7 fracture; reorientation and renewal map to Phases 8–10 (educational framing, not medical advice).
crossDomainExamples.environment: Ecosystem tipping points (coral bleaching, desertification) = Phase 7; regenerative, closed-loop redesign = Phases 8–10.
crossDomainExamples.psychology: Grief and individuation move through descent (3), stillness (4), conscience (8), and integration (10).

references: Panarchy / Adaptive Cycle — Gunderson & Holling (r → K → Ω → α)
Systems ecology — Odum's energy circuit language
safeQuotes: There is nothing new under the sun. But there is always something alive inside it.
It's not a theory of everything. It's a theory of everything that returns.
guards: No medical advice or supplement/TRT dosing presented as prescription — educational only, recommend professional consultation.
No financial guarantees or return promises.
Do NOT reproduce the Phase Kernel formula or any patent specifics.

cards.title: LIMEN Helix — The Midlife Fracture (Phase 7 Physiology)
cards.thesis: Midlife neuroendocrine change maps to a Phase-7 fracture — it moves hormonal, cognitive, and identity layers together. Durable recovery follows the Phase 8–10 arc: conscience (assess + restore inner rhythm) → threshold (reorient identity) → resurrection (integrated, sustainable form).
concepts: Phase 7 is a structural fracture, not just a mood — neuroendocrine + cognitive + identity shift in concert.
Recovery is a sequence (8 conscience → 9 threshold → 10 resurrection), not a single fix.
Inner rhythm (sleep, circadian, parasympathetic tone) must precede outer strength.

crossDomainExamples.physiology: Testosterone:cortisol ratio inversion under chronic strain; dopaminergic slowdown; inflammatory drift.
crossDomainExamples.psychology: Identity disintegration and emotional lability at the fracture; reintegration in Phases 8–10.
crossDomainExamples.ritual: Traditional rites of passage encode the same descent-and-return for midlife transition.

safeQuotes: The system is stuck at the point of fracture with no internal rhythm for return.
guards: EDUCATIONAL ONLY — not medical advice; never present dosing or TRT as prescription; recommend a qualified clinician.
No Phase Kernel formula or patent specifics.

cards.title: LIMEN Helix — Tipping Points & Regeneration (Systems / Ecology)
cards.thesis: Environmental and infrastructural systems follow the same arc: most failure comes from staying stuck in Phases 5–7 (chronic strain → tipping point); most innovation arises in Phases 8–10, once a system becomes self-aware, adaptive, and regenerative.
concepts: Phase 7 = the tipping point / Ω-collapse where resilience boundaries are crossed.
The framework overlays established models (Panarchy, resilience engineering) — diagnostic language, not new science.
Completing the spiral (closed loops, circular design) is what turns collapse into renewal.

crossDomainExamples.water: Aquifer collapse (7) → closed-loop reuse / net-zero water districts (10).

safeQuotes: It frames system fracture not as failure — but as the opening for engineered rebirth.
guards: Educational; cite established models, no overclaiming.

cards.title: LIMEN Helix — The Theology of Return (Ecclesiastes)
cards.thesis: Ecclesiastes names the cycle ('nothing new under the sun') and stops at the silence; the LIMEN arc picks it up — meaning is found not in novelty but in the rhythm and the return (Phase 10, resurrection).
concepts: Seeing the cycle (Solomon) versus completing it (the return).
Meaning lives in the rhythm — the returning breath — not in the new.
Collapse (7b divergence) is not the end; the spiral can resurrect.

crossDomainExamples.scripture: 'There is nothing new under the sun' — the cycle named but not completed.
crossDomainExamples.ritual: Rites of passage across traditions encode the descent-and-return arc.

safeQuotes: There is nothing new under the sun. But there is always something alive inside it.
You stopped at the silence. I picked it up in silence, and walked it back toward the song.
guards: Respectful across traditions; no doctrinal claims presented as authority.
